verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes offers filesystem watching (inotify-based `sandbox.watch()`) that can fire callbacks on file events, and intercepting outbound HTTP via Workers, which are event-triggered building blocks, but there is no first-class 'rules engine' or declarative trigger/action automation system for arbitrary events. Automation must be hand-built in Worker code around these primitives rather than configured as rules. missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger-action framework, event types beyond filesystem/HTTP, and any community or hands-on evidence of automation workflows being built this way.
